tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---FILES---"; ls -la data/; echo "---HEAD1---"; head -5 data/transactions_export_1.csv; echo "---HEAD2---"; head -5 data/transactions_export_2.csv; echo "---WC---"; wc -l data/transactions_export_*.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1

hops fg create transactionsc0b4ca \
  --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,category:string" \
  --description "Transactions feature group with online store enabled" \
  2>&1
hops fg insert transactionsc0b4ca --version 1 --file data/transactions_export_1.csv 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert transactionsc0b4ca --version 1 --file data/transactions_export_2.csv 2>&1 | tail -20
tail -n +2 data/transactions_export_1.csv data/transactions_export_2.csv | grep -v '==>' | grep -v '^$' | cut -d, -f1 | sort -u | wc -l
tool_input.description: Count distinct row_ids across both files

tool_input.command: hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM transactionsc0b4ca_1" 2>&1 | tail -15
hops --no-verify sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM transactionsc0b4ca_1" 2>&1 | tail -15
